input:
They’re not happy with the new figures, and it’s becoming a recurring theme.
High-value accounts are unhappy with renewal price increases.

how are tasks assigned when a claim hits a threshold that requires manual review?
Uncertainty about how tasks are assigned for claims needing manual review.

We’ve been trying to use the bulk ... but it’s still not handling upload files together reliably — we ... get timeouts on batches over 50 documents.
Bulk uploads time out when processing large batches of documents.

Can you walk me through how to attach supporting documents to a claims file in the system?
The user does not know how to attach supporting documents to a claims file.

No delegate at all — and it’s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.
The lack of a delegate causes delays in reserve updates that require sign‑off before payments can be processed.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates.
Claim progress updates are sent manually, causing delays and missed communications.

Exactly. That’s the problem — no warning, no link option, just two claims.
The system provides no warning or link option, only showing two claims.

Also, your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly.
Unexpected interface changes force staff to be retrained repeatedly.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual ... control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing.
The team needs both automatic routing by postcode and manual control for complex cases, causing a conflict.

Great. And just to confirm — does the system allow us to set up custom reporting dashboards for our internal teams?
Uncertainty about the platform's ability to create custom reporting dashboards for internal teams.

it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions
The platform is delaying payments, causing supplier concerns.

we’re seeing ... pushback from policyholders on renewal pricing — it’s hitting our top accounts hardest.
Policyholders are pushing back on renewal pricing, especially affecting top accounts.

It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
Missing repair updates force the team to stop their work and call suppliers for information.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim, and it’s holding up our payment cycle.
The user cannot pull the latest reserves report for a high‑value marine claim, delaying payments.

Exactly — we’re drowning in supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and our reporting is all over the place.
The team is overwhelmed by manual supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and their reporting is disorganized.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the reserves for our latest batch of claims but the system isn’t pulling through the supplier payments correctly — any idea what might be causing that?
The system fails to pull supplier payments correctly during reserve reconciliation.

We’re drowning in repair updates missing again this week — it’s eating into our daily tasks. We’re stuck calling garages every day because repair updates missing — it’s a constant drag on our team’s productivity and delays claim resolution.
Repair updates are frequently missing, forcing the team to manually chase garages and slowing claim resolution.

Appreciate the quick response. We’ve double-checked the roles and tasks assigned — everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.
The reported numbers are incorrect and do not match the data they submitted last week.

we’re having trouble pulling updated reserves for our high-value claims this morning
They cannot retrieve the latest reserve amounts for high-value claims.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard to upload documents.
The user cannot log in to the claims dashboard because they have forgotten their password.

Could you walk me through how to upload supporting documents for a claim? I keep getting stuck at the supplier validation step.
The user cannot complete the upload of supporting documents because they get stuck at the supplier validation step.

Hi Deryn, I’m Gellin from Saltmarsh Specialty — we’ve got a few claims held up because the approver’s out and no one’s covering their queue.
Claims are delayed because the approver is absent and no one is covering their queue.

I also need to sync up on the tasks for policyholders and make sure the integrations are pulling correctly.
Need to verify that policyholder tasks and integrations are syncing correctly.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5... Documents: click "Open"
The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type.

We’ve got a few high-ARR clients asking why their renewal quotes jumped—can you help us explain that?
Clients are confused about why their renewal quotes increased.

Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases — we need per-team configuration.
The platform doesn’t let each team choose between automatic and manual claim allocation, causing a conflict between motor and commercial teams.

Right, but it’s still a contract cost complaint we need to explain to them, and it’s causing friction with key accounts. ... they’re comparing last year’s rate and want to know why it’s higher now.
Customers are questioning why their contract cost has increased compared to the previous year.

I’m trying to upload some policyholder documents for a recent claim but the interface isn’t showing the upload field — is there a permissions issue or a step I’m missing?
The upload field for adding policyholder documents is not visible, possibly due to permissions or a missing step.

I can’t access the documents section — it’s saying my credentials are expired.
The user’s credentials have expired, blocking access to the documents section.

First, we’re spending too much time calling garages because we can’t see live repair updates — it’s a daily grind.
We waste a lot of time calling garages because we lack live repair updates.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble logging into Keelwater to upload the policyholder documents for our latest claim.
The user cannot log in to Keilwater to upload claim documents.

our handlers are spending half their day calling garages because we can’t see live repair progress in the system
Handlers waste half their day calling garages because the system doesn't show live repair progress.

Finance keeps questioning the numbers because the dashboard totals don’t match the export figures mismatch — I’ve re-exported three times and it’s consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time.
Dashboard totals differ from exported figures, causing finance to doubt the numbers.

We’re evaluating integrations next quarter — does your platform support API hooks for our legacy document system?
The customer needs to know if the platform can integrate with their existing legacy document system.

I understand it’s not a bug in the software, but we need to justify this to our finance team... it’s a renewal price concern we’re trying to negotiate fairly.
The customer must justify a renewal price increase to their finance team.

That’ll be useful — we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance.
The customer lacks sufficient visibility into reserves and supplier performance.

Appreciate you logging that. We handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, so eye comfort matters.
The user finds the current interface hard on the eyes during late-night work.

We’ve had to retrain our claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes — it’s disruptive and costly
Unannounced interface changes force the claims team to undergo frequent retraining, causing disruption and extra cost.

We’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes — any chance we can get dark mode enabled?
The bright interface strains users' eyes when they run reports late at night.

We handle hundreds daily and need bulk uploads. We’re reviewing our licensing tiers to see if we can adjust for higher document volume without increasing per-claim costs.
The customer needs a way to upload hundreds of files each day in bulk without raising per‑claim costs.

We often need to upload files together when opening a new claim, especially when policyholders send in bundles. Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
Uploading multiple files for a new claim must be done individually, which is slow.

It’s the MI dashboard versus the CSV export... The numbers don’t line up, and finance is questioning which one to trust.
The MI dashboard numbers conflict with the CSV export, causing finance to doubt which source is correct.

We’ve had a few false alarms lately where Keelwater appears down, but it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our VPN acting up again.
Keelwater shows false downtime alerts caused by the customer's own network issues.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to check my reserves or documents.
The user cannot log in because they forgot their password.

We just need some stability so we can focus on policyholders, not relearning the software.
The software is unstable, forcing users to constantly relearn it instead of focusing on their policyholders.

Got it, that worked perfectly. Also, can we adjust the reserves on policyholder claims without triggering alerts?
Users cannot change claim reserves without generating system alerts.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to figure out why the latest payment batch didn’t reflect in our supplier ledger — any idea?
The latest payment batch is not showing up in the supplier ledger.

Appreciate the quick response — I’ve been stuck on this since this morning and it’s holding up the reporting cycle.
The user is unable to resolve an issue that is delaying the reporting cycle.

Also, I need to update the supplier details for a couple of claims — can you help me find where that’s managed?
The user cannot locate where to update supplier details for claims.

is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double‑counted?
Payments can be double-counted because reporting periods aren't locked.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble logging into the system — I think I need to reset my password. Can you help?
The user cannot log in because they think their password needs to be reset.

Also, can we get a summary of recent tasks and letters tied to our account?
The customer cannot easily view a summary of recent tasks and letters linked to their account.

We’re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake, and it’s causing duplicate records.
Duplicate claims are created because the system doesn't alert when the same policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels.

And when reserves go over limit? The approval waiting list just ... if the approver’s out.
Approvals get stuck when reserves exceed the limit and the approver is unavailable.

Hi Bryn, we’re getting locked out of Keelwater every time we try to log in — it keeps saying the system is down, but I’m pretty sure it’s not actually your side.
Users are locked out when trying to log in, receiving a false "system is down" message.

Appreciate that — we’re keen to understand how the system handles multi-user workflows without overlapping actions.
The customer is unsure how the platform prevents users from stepping on each other's toes during shared workflows.

can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?
The user cannot manually merge duplicate records without risking loss of documents or supplier notes.

Got it working! Must’ve been the VPN... you saved me from a whole afternoon of claims reporting ... delays.
VPN connectivity issues caused claims reporting delays.

Exactly — it’s not just delays, it’s affecting policyholder trust too.
Claims delays are eroding policyholder trust.

Well, the issue is that last week the claims dashboard suddenly shifted where the reserves tab sits — no heads-up, no training notes, nothing.
The reserves tab on the claims dashboard moved without any notice or guidance, causing confusion.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
Users have to click the "Document type" button repeatedly, causing frustration.

We’re working on enabling customer milestone messaging so policyholders get timely updates at claim milestones — it’s still in development but we’re aiming to deliver it early next year.
Policyholders are not receiving timely updates at claim milestones.

It’s mostly around the renewal price. We’ve seen some shifts that feel out of step with what we’ve budgeted for. I’m really hoping we can revisit the renewal price concern — it’s hitting us harder than expected, especially since we use your claims and reporting tools so intensively.
The renewal price increase is exceeding the customer's budget.

it’s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed. We’re seeing claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver’s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list — policyholders are noticing delays.
Claims get stuck in a backlog because reserve changes that exceed authority sit in a single approver’s queue with no delegate.
